DJ Set

DJ KOCO aka SHIMOKITA FIRST TIME IN ATHENS! SPECIAL GUESTS TIME FLIES

Σάββατο 4 Απριλίου στις 00:00 | Gazarte

The needle drops and the sample arrives from somewhere deep in the crates. DJ KOCO is behind the decks at Gazarte, and what happens next will require your full attention. This isn't DJing as contemporary practice. This is DJing as archaeology, as curation, as live demonstration of what vinyl still offers.

DJ KOCO aka SHIMOKITA has built a global reputation through an approach that seems anachronistic but proves essential. While most DJs work from digital libraries, KOCO works from records, his collection representing decades of digging through Tokyo's legendary stores and beyond. When he selects a track, he's selecting from physical objects he owns, their history in his hands.

The technique goes beyond mere vinyl preference. KOCO's mixing style prioritizes the groove that specific pressings carry, that warmth that digital can approximate but not replicate. His selections move through hip-hop's history, funk's foundations, and the global sounds that connect them. The education he provides is implicit, each track choice teaching through example.

Gazarte provides the appropriate venue. The Roof Stage or Main Stage offers space for the crowd that KOCO draws, serious diggers mixing with curious newcomers. The sound system respects the frequencies that vinyl delivers, that analog spectrum that digital encoding loses.

The crowd for DJ KOCO events brings particular intensity. You'll find record collectors who recognize samples before they complete, hip-hop heads who understand the tradition KOCO represents, and dancers who simply respond to what works. The energy is focused, people paying attention to what's being played rather than using it as background.

What makes KOCO distinctive is his refusal to separate DJ from curator. Every set is a statement about what music matters, what connections exist between tracks, what vinyl's survival means. By the time he finishes, you've received an education disguised as a party.

If you need contemporary drops and familiar playlists, KOCO operates in different territory. His sets reward knowledge and attention, the pleasure deepening with understanding. But if you've been searching for DJing as craft rather than technology, if you want to hear what the best crate-diggers have excavated, you find your way to Gazarte.
